title: International Student Visa Help
scenario: A consultant promises visa renewal approval if you pay today by wire transfer.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: International Student Visa Help: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Immigration outcomes cannot be guaranteed by private callers.
